sentences.en: Laws to prevent computer crimes were enacted in the USA.
sentences.zh: 美国通过了防止计算机犯罪的法律。

sentences.en: The bill is expected to be enacted during the present session.
sentences.zh: 预计该法案将在本次会期内获得通过。

sentences.en: Congress failed to enact any useful legislation during the entire session.
sentences.zh: 整个会期中，国会未能通过任何有意义的立法。
